hello.title: Hi! I'm Chai
hello.text: I'll help you start speaking English, without cramming or boring textbooks.

lessons.title: 5 minutes a day
lessons.text: Short lessons matched to your level, from A1 to C1. XP and a daily streak keep you going.

talk.title: Speak out loud
talk.text: AI teachers are available 24/7. They correct mistakes gently and switch to Russian if you get stuck.

install.title: Add Talkreal to your Home Screen
install.text: It will open like a regular app.

home.levelDoneText: You have finished every lesson at this level. Ready for the next one?
home.noLessons: Lessons for this level are coming soon.

mascot.morning: Good morning! Five minutes of English and the day starts right.
mascot.day: Hi! A good moment for a short lesson.
mascot.evening: Good evening! Shall we end the day with a couple of new phrases?
mascot.streak_one: {{count}} day in a row! Keep it up.
mascot.streak_other: {{count}} days in a row! Keep it up.

talk.title: Teachers
talk.subtitle: Conversations with the teachers are coming very soon. Meanwhile, meet the team.
talk.subtitleLive: Call a teacher or write to them. They answer, gently correct your mistakes, and send a review after a call.
talk.noTime: You have used today's speaking time. Come back tomorrow!
talk.lessonHint: Choose a teacher to practise the lesson in conversation.

harper.style: Warm and precise. Explains a rule so that it finally sticks.

jake.style: Relaxed and fun. Small talk, slang and phrases from real life.

elena.style: Explains in Russian when it gets hard. Ideal if you're just starting.

sterling.style: Interviews, calls and negotiations. Clear and to the point.

placement.title: What's your level?
placement.subtitle: It decides which lessons you see. The test takes a couple of minutes, or you can pick your level yourself.
placement.resultText: We've matched the lessons to this level. You can always change it in your profile.

rules.title: Rules for messages
rules.english: Write in English: this is a place to practise.
rules.kind: Be polite. Insults, harassment and spam are not allowed.
rules.contacts: Do not share phone numbers, emails, messenger names or links, and do not ask others for them.
rules.checked: Every message is checked automatically before it is sent. A Talkreal moderator may read a conversation to deal with a complaint or a breach of the rules.
rules.report: If someone makes you uncomfortable, block or report them: the “⋯” button in the conversation.
rules.adult: I am 18 or older and I accept the rules.
